disposition: Run the single permitted independent confirmation, exactly reproducing the development's candidate 0e16077e, weights (holding 0.10, terminal 0.10), recovery on, feasible_return_budget 15, substeps 1, seed 17 and named zero initial state, with preceding_execution set to the development feedback reference 21a10d08; no scientific setting is altered. Then STOP regardless of outcome, reporting the development and confirmation distinctly and claiming repetition only, never robustness.
expected_observation: An independent launch returns a new, valid, complete execution with sampled holding max speed <= 0.02 m/s across the inclusive .30-.35s window and holding/terminal position within 0.01 m, i.e. the decoded acceptance repeats; because the solver never converges and stops are wall-clock/seed dependent, an identical result is a repetition of the same configuration rather than evidence of robustness.
fixed_conditions: Frozen task unchanged: two flexible segments 0.16/0.11 m, six ideal tension channels 0..8 N, structural_linear mesh 24, named zero initial positions/velocities with seed 17, 0.35 s duration, 0.01 s control and sample period, 0.0005 s physics step, holding window .30-.35s inclusive of 6 samples, .01 m position and .02 m/s holding-speed limits, 35 input switches. Controller unchanged from the development except that nothing is changed: feasible_return_budget 15 s, CPU 30 s, iterations 120, minimum 5 s / relative improvement 0.1, tolerance 1e-6, substeps 1, recover_returned_tensions true, holding_tip_speed_weight 0.10, terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.10, tracking 1.0, horizon 10, scales and initialization identical.
hypothesis: The accepted development outcome (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.10 with recovery on, sampled holding max speed 0.008583 m/s) is reproducible under one independent launch with the identical candidate, seed, initial state and acceptance, rather than being a single wall-clock-dependent solve artifact.
limitations: A same-seed independent run establishes repetition only; it cannot support any robustness, real-time or hardware claim and does not establish a unique cause.
Nine of the solver stops in the development were relative-seed/budget/verified-seed rather than converged, so wall-clock and initialization reuse can still produce different accepted iterates.
Six-point inclusive holding sampling is not a continuous-time guarantee.
If this confirmation returns the identical evidence reference it is a repeated reference, not a new execution, and must not be counted as a second launch.
revision_or_stop_rule: After this single confirmation, STOP unconditionally and take no further tuning trial; if the confirmation returns a new execution, report its holding/position/terminal values alongside the development and state whether the acceptance repeated; if it returns the development's own reference, report that no independent new execution was obtained and STOP.
weakening_observation: If the confirmation yields holding max speed above 0.02 m/s or any position/terminal-limit failure, the single-weight improvement does not repeat and the accepted development must be reported as a one-run observation; if it returns the same artifact reference, no independent evidence was produced.
